segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin report the toner hydrates without feeling greasy or heavy, and some use it successfully layered under makeup with primer/powder, though one oily-skinned reviewer found it too watery to feel like it did much.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, chronically dry, or postpartum-dry skin frequently describe it as a strong hydration boost that reduces flaking and tightness, though a couple of dry-skinned reviewers felt it did not absorb or hydrate enough for their needs.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report good hydration on dry areas without added oiliness in the T-zone and no breakouts, though one combination-skin reviewer broke out and another found the texture heavy and congesting.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin describe it as calming, non-irritating, and reducing redness, but a notable minority with self-described sensitive or non-sensitive skin report burning, whiteheads, rashes, or rosacea flare-ups.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (in their late 40s to 80s) mostly praise the hydration and glow, though one 47-year-old reviewer broke out shortly after applying it.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-dry skin found the texture pleasant and hydrating but noted mild concerns after extended use.

concerns.aging: Older reviewers (mid-50s to nearly 80) report soft, smooth, hydrated skin and compliments on their complexion; no negative aging-specific effects are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe visible relief from dryness, flakiness, and tightness, including postpartum and desert-climate dryness; a few report no noticeable hydration improvement even after multiple layers.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness report visible calming and reduced redness after consistent use; conversely, others describe new redness, irritation, or rosacea flare-ups triggered by the product.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers credit the toner with strengthening or supporting a compromised skin barrier and easing dryness from retinoid (Tretinoin) use; one reviewer felt her barrier symptoms (congestion) worsened.
concerns.spots: Not enough distinct reviewer commentary on hyperpigmentation or dark spots specifically to characterize this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even clearer skin with continued use; however, a substantial group reports breakouts, cystic acne, or whiteheads appearing within a day to a few weeks of starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers commonly state the toner hydrates without adding shine or making skin feel oily, describing it as lightweight and glow-inducing rather than greasy.

aspects.libelle: Large bottle size relative to hydration delivered

extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin and one use of this and my skin is destroyed…. Burning and red and loads of small whiteheads all over my skin… terrible terrible terrible!!! I threw it away faster than anything I have ever thrown away….

after hearing youtube rave about this toner, I gave it a try. I have mature,dry, not overly sensitive skin and this gave me burning, pebble textured skin. there is at least one ingredient that is irritating. I see now that others have had an issue as well.

I love this toner! For someone with rosacea & super sensitive skin, this toner is truly amazing. No burning or stinging, just pure comfort. The toner also doesn't dry out your skin or leave it sticky like other toners. I use it with the Milky Moisture Cleanser & finish my routine with the Moisturizing Gel Cream. At 61, I receive numerous compliments on how soft & smooth my skin looks.This isn't skincare - this is skinlove!

My skin is very oily and acne prone so I hesitate to try new products but I'm glad I tried this one. I use it after I wash my face morning and night and my acne actually cleared up (knock on wood) because I believe this toner actually helped my skin barrier become stronger.

I absolutely LOVE this toner!! I have combination skin (oily T Zone and normal-dry cheeks), and this is my holy grail, SERIOUSLY! I love that the milky "texture" instantly hydrates my skin, especially since i get dry after washing my face. It's lightweight and unscented which is another factor that i love. I would definitely recommend this for all skin types.

I really wanted to love Byoma, especially with all the hype around the barrier‑boosting formulas, but it just didn't work for my skin. The textures felt a bit heavy and didn't absorb the way I expected. After a few weeks of consistent use, I didn't notice much improvement—if anything, my skin felt a little congested. The packaging is cute and the price point is great, but overall the products just didn't deliver the results I was hoping for. It might work for other skin types, but it wasn't the right fit for me.

extraits.texte: i have rosacea, uneven texture, and dry skin—toner has always been a challenge for me! this, however, is my holy grail product. got mini's for a girl's night in gift bags!
